facts.claim: Stripe is financial infrastructure designed to grow revenue.
facts.quote: Financial infrastructure to grow your revenue. Accept payments, offer financial services, and implement custom revenue models

facts.claim: Stripe processed $1.9T in payment volume in 2025.
Stripe offers an enterprise-grade infrastructure for modern payments.
facts.quote: Stripe offers an enterprise-grade infrastructure that puts our customers on the cutting edge of modern payments technology.
Our goal is to get faster as Stripe grows. We also revere craftsmanship and obsess over every detail.

facts.claim: Stripe is building infrastructure for AI and software autonomy.
facts.quote: Stripe is building infrastructure to make it possible, including real-time agent micropayments, protocols that let software transact autonomously

facts.claim: Stripe looks for people who like hard problems and urgency.
facts.quote: we are looking for people who move with urgency, who like hard problems, and who want their work to matter

facts.claim: Stripe's Global Payments and Treasury Network optimizes global money movement.
facts.quote: a programmable infrastructure for global money movement that batches transfers to reduce cost, nets opposing flows to minimize actual cash moved

signals.text: Emphasize experience building reliable infrastructure that processes large-scale global transactions.
Show ability to balance speed with high craftsmanship.
Highlight ability to tackle hard problems with urgency.
